bullets.title: META: Watermelon AI model speculation drives +4% surge, leads Mag7
bullets.body: META shares up ~4% to $745 (up $26.33), best performer among Mag7, on speculation of an imminent 'Watermelon' AI model launch next week. Catalyst was Zuckerberg and Chief AI Officer Alexander Wang posting watermelon emojis over the weekend; prior reports had indicated a October target for the model. META also partnering with WMT on agentic commerce at low-single-digit % commission on agent-driven traffic.

bullets.title: CRM: BofA double-upgrades to Buy, raises PT to $285 from $160 (24% upside)
bullets.body: BofA's Tal Liani upgraded Salesforce from Underperform to Buy and lifted the PT to $285 from $160, implying 24% upside from ~$229. The stock rallied 3.8% in pre-market to $237.79. BofA also has CRM acquiring AI analytics platform Loops.

bullets.title: ADBE: Wells Fargo downgrades to Underweight, cuts PT to $225 from $270
bullets.body: Wells Fargo downgraded Adobe to Underweight from Overweight and slashed the price target to $225 from $270; stock fell 3.9% pre-market to $232.84. The move stands in contrast to BofA's Salesforce upgrade, signaling divergence within enterprise software.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max orders cut -15%; bull case challenged
bullets.body: MS flags that Apple cut iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max production orders by 15%, with the timing unusually early post-launch. JPM simultaneously raised AAPL PT to $360 (from $340) on ASP-driven cycle (+10% YoY pricing), guiding F4Q26 revenue $112.9B (+10% YoY) and F1Q27 $147.9B; Dec-Q volume down ~18% YoY to 69M units but ASP +20%. SWKS flagged as most exposed to the cuts; QCOM has minimal iPhone exposure.

bullets.title: NVDA: MSFT Maia 300 reduces GPU dependency; NVDA/Cisco USFP optics standard announced
bullets.body: Microsoft announced Azure Maia 300 delivers 40% more tokens per megawatt vs. leading GPUs and will scale to multi-gigawatt deployments by 2027, explicitly reducing reliance on external GPU suppliers. Separately, NVIDIA and Cisco introduced the USFP optics standard supporting 400Gb/s-per-lane with 4x bandwidth density. NVDA supply chain continues to see price increases to offset rising memory costs; NVDA also in early-stage talks to acquire Reflection AI (has invested $800M).

bullets.title: MU: Down 4% on CXMT 4F memory architecture threat; HBM bull case intact
bullets.body: Micron fell 4% after China's CXMT announced a 4F cell architecture for server memory rolling out by end-2026, two years ahead of Samsung's 2028 goal and with no announced 4F roadmap from Micron. Offsetting the concern, JPM notes MU's SCA/LTA framework locks in >75% FY27 output with HBM pricing up 54%/25% YoY for CY27/28; UBS also flags MU's $35B buyback may be 'just the start.'

bullets.title: MRVL: FY28 guidance raised; FY31 target $70-90B implying $34 EPS
bullets.body: Wolfe Research highlights that Marvell raised FY28 guidance and guided FY31 revenue to $70-90B with ~35% CAGR through 2030, implying $34 EPS. Custom AI/XPU attach diversification cited as key driver. Marvell also projects data-center capex reaching $3T by 2030. JPM names MRVL as a top semi pick alongside AVGO.

bullets.title: FSLR: Truist upgrades to Buy, PT $270 from $229; stock +2.9% pre-market
bullets.body: Truist upgraded First Solar to Buy from Hold and raised the PT to $270 from $229, citing a stronger demand backdrop and anti-stockpiling measures under Section 232 with incremental upside from international production. FSLR rallied 2.9% to $182.95 pre-market with options volume 212% above 30-day average (63,689 contracts, P/C 1.22).

bullets.title: DKNG: Citi cuts PT to $28 from $32; NFL Week 5 hold headwinds compound estimate cuts
bullets.body: Citi cut DKNG's 3Q/4Q EBITDA estimates by $50M/$70M on prediction market customer acquisition spend, with FY27/FY28 EBITDA down $115M/$284M; PT cut to $28 (14x 2027 EBITDA). NFL Week 5 compounded the pain: public ATS win rate 64% (vs 43% YoY), Over/Under hit rate 86%, making it the 4th below-average hold week to start the season.

bullets.title: CRWV: Anthropic analyst day Wednesday is key binary catalyst for compute names
bullets.body: Multiple sources flag Anthropic's Wednesday analyst day as the single most important near-term AI catalyst: ARR above $100B exiting 2026 while token prices fall would validate the AI buildout thesis and be strongly positive for compute plays like CRWV. B300 spot prices hit a new high of $7.29/hr (NBIS raised rates to $9/hr); a miss or plateau would trigger compute price 'catch-down' and depress 2029 capex expectations. Anthropic also entered a multiyear cloud deal with IREN.

bullets.title: MSFT: Nadella AI 'emergency brake' essay flags cyber implications; watch cybersecurity
bullets.body: Microsoft CEO Nadella published an essay framing advanced AI models as potential insider threats and calling for emergency brake systems; Citi flags this as a positive read-through for cybersecurity names. MSFT PT maintained at $515 by Phillips Securities (downgraded to Neutral from Accumulate).

bullets.title: PLTR, TEAM at 52-week highs; CHTR, OKLO, SMR at 52-week lows
bullets.body: PLTR hit a 52-week high at $207.80 (+12.1% YTD) and TEAM at $207.90 (+40.7% YTD). On the downside, CHTR fell to a 52-week low at $102.40 (-61.4% YTD), OKLO at $32.90 (-76.2% YTD), and SMR at $6.80 (-83.2% YTD). Phillips Securities also downgraded PLTR to Neutral from Buy with a $215 PT.

bullets.title: AMZN: In talks to acquire Decart AI for ~$7B; NVDA also pursuing Reflection AI
bullets.body: Amazon is in discussions to acquire AI startup Decart for approximately $7B in a deal that also involves Anthropic, NBIS, and NVDA. Separately, NVIDIA is in early-stage talks to acquire Reflection AI, having already invested $800M in the startup.

bullets.title: EXPE/BKNG: MS sees agentic AI shifting hotel bookings direct, cautious on OTAs
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley argues agentic AI strongly favors hotel loyalty programs (74-97% of LLM results link to official hotel sites vs 8-13% on Google), driving 250-400bps shift to direct bookings and 50-75bps lower OTA commissions. 2028E EBITDA for MAR/HLT/H/WH seen 3-9% above consensus; EXPE consensus 2% below. BKNG PT unchanged at $230; EXPE unchanged at $235 but flagged as competitively disadvantaged.

bullets.title: SPX 3Q26 earnings preview: +26.7% EPS growth led by MU, NVDA, META
bullets.body: Consensus expects SPX 3Q26 EPS growth of +26.7% YoY and revenue +9.9% YoY, both well above historical averages. MU, NVDA, and META are the top three single-name contributors; Mag7 accounts for ~26% of SPX EPS growth and AI Tech (ex-NVDA) ~35%. Energy leads at +120% YoY; Consumer Discretionary is the only sector with negative EPS growth at -2% YoY.

bullets.title: WDAY: Analyst Day tomorrow (Oct 13) at 5pm ET; long-term financial targets expected
bullets.body: Workday's Analyst Day is scheduled for October 13 at 17:00 ET and may include long-term financial targets based on prior investor meeting formats. Last guided Q3 and FY earnings on August 27.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS upgrades to Buy, $275 PT ahead of analyst day showcasing AI alliances
bullets.body: UBS upgraded Accenture to Buy with a $275 price target, citing the upcoming analyst day as a catalyst to clarify 2027+ long-term growth, AI alliance momentum, cyber expansion, and durable margin improvement.

bullets.title: MS QDS: Earnings vol cheap vs. recent; CMCSA, WDC, META screen as opportunities
bullets.body: MS Quantitative and Derivative Strategies flags 4Q26 implied earnings moves (4.7-4.9% avg) below 8-quarter realized moves across the Russell 1000. Three universe names screen as having elevated hit ratios and vol discounts: CMCSA (100% hit ratio, 5.6% implied vs 7.3% realized), WDC (63% hit, 5.2% vs 7.5%), and META (63% hit, 6.3% vs 7.4%).

bullets.title: MSFT Maia 300 / custom silicon: 40% more tokens/MW, scales to multi-GW by 2027
bullets.body: Microsoft's Maia 300 custom AI chip delivers 40% more tokens per megawatt vs. leading GPU systems, 7x rack-scale throughput vs. Maia 200, and will expand to multi-gigawatt deployments starting 2027. Maia 300 includes eight HBM4 stacks with 18.0 TB/s peak memory bandwidth at 950W TDP. This is an explicit move to reduce NVDA GPU dependency in MSFT's own workloads.

bullets.title: CEG, VST, TLN: 'Coiled Spring' AI power names preferred; FERC PJM ruling positive for IPPs
bullets.body: 22V Research flags CEG, VST, and TLN as 'Coiled Springs' that react more strongly to positive AI power catalysts and are the preferred way to own AI power exposure. FERC's approval of 50MW cumulative Large Load definition for PJM and rejection of more restrictive data center rules is viewed as a net positive for IPPs per MS.
